title: Textbooks on programming-language design, semantics and implementation
description: Language-independent books (level 2) on programming-language concepts, formal semantics, type theory, compilers, interpreters, runtime systems, automata/computability and database query-language theory. Books that are openly online carry chapter-level deep links tagged with concept ids; paywalled books link to the author or publisher page.
